name: ABYAT
note: Live-fetched Kuwait City-HQ'd home/furniture megastore with KWD pricing, hundreds of consumer SKUs and a real cart; consumer home retail in the SACO/Safat Home pattern, not a B2B building-materials distributor. Clears all gates.

name: aDawliah Electronics
note: Gate 2 fail: the company's own materials describe it as both retailer AND distributor engaged in 'retail, distribution, installation and integration' of professional AV, CCTV, security, access-control and pro-audio systems, a hybrid B2B/B2C model whose B2B/systems-integration side alone hard-excludes it.

name: Al Andalus Trading Establishment Company
note: Gate 2 fail: its own about-us page states it is 'the sole distributer of Samsung, Hisense, Ariston and Ferre in Kuwait'. A national sole distributor supplying the trade is exactly the hybrid B2B distribution model the gate hard-excludes even when a genuine showroom/retail arm exists.

name: Al Hasawi Industrial Group
note: Gate 6: the tagged parent mixes retail franchises (Ace, Sears, Peak, Dadida) with refrigerator/AC/water-cooler manufacturing (Al Hasawi factories), a hard exclusion, so the parent is excluded; the Ace retail sub could be broken out separately, but its hardware/DIY line also sits on the Gate 2 construction-hardware boundary. Held pending a clean retail-sub row.

name: AL NASSER
note: Large live Kuwait fashion/footwear/sports retailer, real KWD pricing and working cart; KNet and the footer legal entity confirm Kuwait HQ, 50 stores. Clears all gates.

name: Al Ostoura International Company
note: Old domain is parked/dead but the business migrated to alostouraworld.com per the dead-domain protocol: a live luxury multi-brand fashion store (named designer brands, working cart, Kuwait delivery). Well-known Kuwaiti luxury retailer; clears all gates.

name: Al-Bahar Electronics
note: Independent search resolved the previously-unidentified live domain to cloud9albahar.com (Cloud 9 by Al-Bahar): a live omnichannel consumer-electronics store with brand catalog pages, iOS/Android apps and 3 Kuwait mall stores, run by the Kuwaiti Al-Bahar Electrical Appliances & Electronics Co. WLL. Electronics category, Kuwait HQ, digital channel now confirmed.

name: Aldawaeya

note: Kuwait gaming/electronics retailer (founded 2000; PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo/accessories) with a live e-commerce store. Electronics is approved and Kuwait HQ is confirmed; clears the gates.

note: Gate 6: self-described 'retail and distribution conglomerate', sole distributor of P&G and Roche (large B2B FMCG/pharma wholesale) plus a Real Estate division, is a mixed parent that is excluded; the aaw.com corporate domain also has no unified cart of its own (Gate 4). A specific retail sub would need its own row.

name: AlOthman Fashion
note: Kuwait City-HQ'd luxury fashion retailer, live site with /clothing and /outlet pages and KWD pricing. Fashion is an approved multi-item/seasonal category; clears the gates.

name: Alyasra Group

note: Kuwait perfume/oud/home-fragrance retailer (est. 1985) with a live transactional site, KWD pricing, loyalty program and branches. Fragrance is an approved consumable/repeat category; clears the gates.

name: Apotheca Beauty
note: Kuwait City-HQ'd luxury beauty/skincare retailer on Shopify, 20+ prestige brands, live cart and first-order discount. Approved repeat-purchase category; clears the gates.

name: Atyab Al Marshoud
note: Kuwait perfume retailer (est. 1925) on Shopify with a live cart, KWD pricing and a broad fragrance catalog over the SKU floor. Approved consumable/repeat category; clears the gates.

note: Live large-scale Kuwait kids/baby retailer (HQ Shuwaikh) with thousands of real SKUs across toys/books/games/party/newborn plus its own iOS/Android app. Approved general-merchandise category, broad catalog; clears the gates.
